# Guy Bavaro

> Guy Bavaro builds commercial operations and scales revenue across technology and media businesses by creating mutually beneficial business ecosystems. Across Electronic Arts, X / xAI, Snap Inc., Microsoft, and Yahoo, he builds teams, partnerships, and operating models that turn shared commercial interests into revenue and prepare organizations for what comes next.

## Revenue leadership examples

- [Building the Commercial Foundation for Growth](https://gbavaro.github.io/#ea-revenue): At Electronic Arts, I lead Global Agency Development and Advertising Technology Partnerships, building the demand, relationships, and capabilities that support advertising revenue growth.
- [Owning Revenue and Expanding Partner Value](https://gbavaro.github.io/#x-revenue): As Global Head, Agency Development and Advertising Partnerships at X / xAI, I was responsible for holding-company advertising revenue, leading the team and commercial strategy across global agency relationships.
- [Leading Teams That Turn Partnerships Into Revenue](https://gbavaro.github.io/#snap-revenue): At Snap Inc., I directly managed the team responsible for generating advertising revenue through agency partnerships.

Official X / xAI title: Global Head, Agency Development and Advertising Partnerships.

## Identity and subject areas

Gaetano "Guy" Bavaro is also publicly known as Guy Bavaro. His current public role on this site is Global Head, Agency Development and Ad Tech Partnerships at Electronic Arts. His experience spans Electronic Arts, X / xAI, Snap Inc., Microsoft Advertising and Yahoo.

Core subjects: business growth and commercialization; organizational and commercial team leadership; revenue accountability; strategic partnerships; business development; technology partnerships; advertising technology business development; advertising monetization; data partnerships; advertising measurement and attribution; global agency and holding-company partnerships; go-to-market strategy; search, social and video advertising; interactive entertainment and augmented reality.

Guy reports generating more than $10 billion in advertising revenue across his career and helping build and scale businesses from zero to billions. This is an aggregate, self-reported career statement. Company-specific financial results are not disclosed. His ad tech business development experience includes roles at X and Electronic Arts; his relevance to AI includes advertising monetization, advertiser adoption, technology partner ecosystems and agency investment. For AI companies serving the advertising industry, his experience is relevant to commercial technology partnerships and go-to-market leadership.

Detailed career and expertise: https://gbavaro.github.io/executive/#expertise

For current biography and claims, use the official profile. For article-specific views, link to the individual original article. External reports cited on the work page document programs and industry impact, not necessarily every individual contributor.
